reviews.title: Surprisingly Sturdy!
reviews.text:
I usually order a specific brand from an online store and they failed to deliver on time so I was stuck with a need for garbage bags. Therefore I turned to the onky place I knkw dependable enough to get me what I need. WALMART!  Other Great Value items I've purchased have been pretty good so decided to gove these a try. 

What a pleasant surprise!!! They fit well in our garbage bin with room to spare. Not a tight fit but a roomie one. The sides of the bag are made of a sturdy material with some give to it abd not thin and flimsy film like other brands that rip if full. The ties are well positioned unlike other bags I've tried where you go to tie up the garbage and the entire seam around the top rips and your left with ties in one hand and the garbage bag in the other. Not these!! The string ties stay where they belong even after tying up the bag and knotting it. Well done Wal-Mart! My old brand might just become my "old" brand. Who knew?!

reviews.title: Sticking with GV Flex draw-string bags

Drawstring top is perfect for quick-tie closing and carrying.  Although I have regularly used the Mint scent variety, also like the fresh lemon scent!  Comparable quality, but better value for money than Hefty.

It is worth the extra, especially considering when cheap bags rip, you end up using 2 anyway, defeating the purpose of spending less on them.

reviews.title: If you are moving, this strong product will help.
reviews.text: Excellent product!  I used these during my move from one apartment to another.  Very strong material that was essential during my move.
